name: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare runs a global network (more than 330 cities in over 125 countries, connected to over 13,000 networks) and sells access to it as subscriptions: security and speed services for websites and apps (firewall, DDoS protection, content delivery, DNS), a Zero Trust and network-security suite that replaces company network hardware (SASE), developer products (Workers, storage, AI inference on GPUs), and a few consumer products. Large customers sign one-to-three-year contracts (often a committed pool of funds); small and mid-size customers pay monthly by credit card, and a large free tier supplies traffic scale that lowers its bandwidth costs. Revenue grew 30 percent to $2.17 billion in FY2025 and 36 percent in Q2 2026, with gross margin around 72 to 75 percent. It is GAAP loss-making because of stock compensation and related payroll taxes ($490 million in FY2025) and a $150.7 million restructuring charge in Q2 2026, but generates free cash flow ($260.6 million, 12 percent of revenue, in FY2025).

employees.note: Full-time employees, 2,452 outside the United States (FY2025 10-K). In May 2026 the company announced a plan reducing about 20% of its workforce (Q2 2026 10-Q), so the current headcount is lower.

businessLines.name: Application services (security, performance and reliability for websites, apps and APIs)
businessLines.how: Subscription per Internet property: Pro and Business plans per domain paid monthly or annually by credit card, and Enterprise contracts of one to three years with a base subscription and sometimes a usage portion for excess bandwidth.
businessLines.description: WAF, bot management, DDoS mitigation, API Shield, CDN, load balancing, DNS, Smart Shield, plus tools to control AI crawlers and agents.

businessLines.name: SASE platform (Zero Trust and workplace security, network services)
businessLines.how: Priced per seat for Zero Trust (monthly for pay-as-you-go, one to three years for contracted customers) and per network for Magic products; large enterprises consolidate vendors onto it.
businessLines.description: Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, WARP client, remote browser isolation, CASB, email security, DLP; Magic WAN, Magic Transit, Magic Firewall, Network Interconnect.

businessLines.name: Developer-based solutions (Workers, AI, storage and databases, media)
businessLines.how: Usage-based plans metered by requests and execution time for pay-as-you-go developers, or committed spend for contracted customers.
businessLines.description: Workers, Workers AI (serverless GPUs), AI Gateway, Vectorize, R2 object storage with no egress fees, D1, Durable Objects, Stream, Images.

businessLines.name: Consumer offerings (1.1.1.1 DNS, WARP VPN, Registrar)
businessLines.how: Small subscription (WARP+) and domain registration fees; mainly a brand and marketing channel and an excluded part of paying-customer counts.
businessLines.description: Free DNS and WARP apps, premium WARP+, domain registration.

brands.name: Cloudflare (Application services, Zero Trust / SASE, Workers developer platform)
brands.share: 100% of revenue; product split not disclosed

brands.share: Purchase consideration $164.2M ($143.0M goodwill); revenue not disclosed (Q2 2026 10-Q)
